label: sec:archimedean-lifting-topological-mass-formula-preamble
html:
The preceding foundations established the jet prolongation over \mathbb{C}, the Yekutieli archimedean band, the \mathrm{QU} \Rightarrow \mathrm{QOU} specialisation, and the exact brane-boundary structure driving the archimedean lift.

This sub-section isolates the topological mass formula's central object: the quantum dilogarithm (the archimedean specialisation of the q-dilogarithm). It states the topological-mass theorem and its conjectural extension. The subsequent sub-section unfolds the theorem's eigenspace, holonomy, transient, and dilogarithm variations.
